Maya (sales): Heads-up: Beacon wants a POC to replace CompetitorX's /generate. Primary: prompt parity, billing delta, SSO + BYOK. Minimal gates?
Diego (solutions): Gates: API envelope mapping, parity tests, token accounting, security signoff, and rollback plan.
Sujata (presales): I'll prepare 8 canonical prompts (summaries, extraction, code). We'll run side-by-side diff + token counts.
Ibrahim (ML Eng): FYI CompetitorX tokenizes some emoji and smart quotes differently; expect small token deltas. We'll include a compat-mode to adjust repetition penalty.
Nina (Security): Need to confirm BYOK flow and SAML metadata. Also legal wants DPA before we ship prompt logs.
Maya (sales): Beacon ok with managed keys for POC, BYOK for production. SSO = SAML, retention <=30d.
infra-bot: staging cluster provisioned: beacon-poc (egress IPs: 52.14.22.10, 52.14.22.11)
Diego (solutions): Adapter example to mimic competitor envelope: {"id":"x","text":"...","usage":{"t":100}} -> {"request_id":"x","choices":[{"text":"..."}],"usage":{"total_tokens":100}}
Sujata (presales): Acceptance criteria draft: mean token delta <=10%, human-pass semantic parity >=90%, latency <=1.5x competitor.
Ibrahim (ML Eng): I'll add model variants (quant, fp16, compat_mode) and record seeds/configs.
Nina (Security): I'll draft the security Q answers and confirm on-prem option.
Maya (sales): Scheduling kickoff Thu 9am PT. Action items: @Sujata harness, @Diego pricing ramp, @Ibrahim variants, @Nina security Q.
